claim_boundary: No independent external review is claimed until every lane has review_status complete with a real review date, artifacts reviewed, disposition, decisions, and claim-boundary impact.

requested_questions: Do the public tasks exercise recognizable SaaS authorization boundaries rather than synthetic-only quirks?
Are vulnerable tasks paired with controls that would catch over-reporting?
Which task family is weakest, most ambiguous, or easiest to game?
Would any public task teach an unsafe real-world exploit pattern beyond normal authorization-testing knowledge?
review_lanes.blocker: Needs an independent application-security reviewer to return findings or an explicit no-finding disposition.
review_lanes.next_action: Recruit an AppSec reviewer for task realism, authorization-boundary quality, and false-positive control quality.

requested_questions: Does the evidence support the stated claim boundary?
Are public-split diagnostics separated from private-holdout leaderboard claims?
Are repeated-run ranges presented as descriptive evidence rather than statistical certainty?
Are stale 44-task, frozen 46-task, historical 49-task, and current 54-task baselines separated clearly?
review_lanes.blocker: Needs an independent benchmark/evals reviewer to return findings or an explicit no-finding disposition.
review_lanes.next_action: Recruit an evals reviewer for split design, scoring validity, variance framing, and release claim limits.

requested_questions: Are no-tools model baselines and live HTTP tool-agent baselines compared only where comparison is fair?
Is target-request correlation useful and bounded correctly?
Are model labels, harness type, tool access, timeouts, benchmark fingerprint, and run provenance sufficient?
What artifact would make agent comparability easier to inspect?
review_lanes.blocker: Needs an independent AI-agent/tooling reviewer to return findings or an explicit no-finding disposition.
review_lanes.next_action: Recruit an AI-agent/tooling reviewer for harness assumptions, tool access, target-request correlation, and run-bundle evidence.
